title: Scattered Spider Hacker Gets Six Years for $11.6 Million Crypto Theft
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Scattered Spider Hacker Gets Six Years for $11.6 Million Crypto Theft

A Scottish hacker tied to Scattered Spider was sentenced to six years in U.S. prison for a SIM-swap and phishing scheme that stole at least $11.6 million in crypto.

This post Scattered Spider Hacker Gets Six Years for $11.6 Million Crypto Theft first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

Ionic Digital (IOND) Sells 737 Bitcoin to Fund Data Center Buildout

Ionic Digital sold about 737 bitcoin for roughly $61.6 million after Sept. 30 and plans to use the cash to develop its data center sites, its latest quarterly report shows.

title: German Court Offers to Drop Movie2k Case for 40,000 Bitcoin
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

German Court Offers to Drop Movie2k Case for 40,000 Bitcoin

A Leipzig judge has offered to dismiss the Movie2k criminal case if the defendant hands over 40,000 bitcoin, which would leave him about 16,000 coins worth roughly $1.02 billion.

This post German Court Offers to Drop Movie2k Case for 40,000 Bitcoin first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
